[[File:GepsGrill-GG7.jpg|thumb|250px|A Whiphid vendor sells bantha burgers and [[dewback ribs]].]]
{{Quote|There is nothing like a bantha burger when you're watching a podrace.|Race announcer|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
A '''bantha burger''' was made from the grilled haunches of a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]], served between two pieces of [[Bread/Legends|bread]]. They were sold by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphids]] [[Fillin Ta]] and [[Norun Gep]], at [[Gep's Grill]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The meat was bought off hunters on the outskirts of Tatooine, and occasionally needed to have the former owner's brand removed before they could be sold. On slow weeks, the Whiphid partners would loot the bantha stalls to supplement their supplies.<ref name="GG7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref>

Bantha [[Burger/Legends|burgers]] were popular with the local workers. Bantha burgers were also sold on several [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], for example in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] found in [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], searched for the occasional voyagers.

[[Trever Flume]] ate a bantha burger in [[Hallitron-7/Legends|Hallitron-7]].
